scenes.title: Research reality
scenes.accessibleDescription: Check the starting assumption before designing around it.

scenes.title: Four evidence labels
scenes.accessibleDescription: Use four labels that make the strength of each claim visible.

scenes.title: Trace one inquiry
scenes.accessibleDescription: Follow a fictional inquiry without contacting real organizers.

scenes.title: Compare the options
scenes.accessibleDescription: A recommendation should explain the tradeoff behind the choice.

scenes.title: Decision ledger
scenes.accessibleDescription: A decision record carries the reason into the next session.

scenes.title: Turn unknowns into work
scenes.accessibleDescription: Turn uncertainty into a named decision or a bounded research task.

scenes.title: Evidence walkthrough
scenes.accessibleDescription: A code file, local test and live observation answer different questions.

scenes.title: Ask a focused question
scenes.accessibleDescription: Replace “research everything” with questions that can be answered.

scenes.title: Fair comparison
scenes.accessibleDescription: Show both the benefit and the cost of each option.

scenes.title: Owner decisions
scenes.accessibleDescription: Reserve owner attention for choices that materially change the product.

scenes.title: A reusable decision
scenes.accessibleDescription: A decision becomes reusable when its context survives the session.

scenes.title: New facts, new plan
scenes.accessibleDescription: A decision ledger supports learning; it prevents silent changes.

scenes.title: Decide with uncertainty
scenes.accessibleDescription: A provisional choice preserves momentum without pretending certainty.
